metadata.description: Skills that turn vibe coding into active, durable learning.

plugins.name: vibe-learning
plugins.description: Built for Claude Code: after each meaningful code change, capture a lesson from the git diff. Each software-engineering keyword gets a docs-based explanation, a first-principles explanation, a real-world example with a commented sample, a docs link, and the actual changed code with its file path. Lessons accumulate as numbered, topic-named files in a vibe-learning/ folder.
